title: 第13章  气吐血了
content_zh:
“苏烬生，我命你们前往灵药峰种植灵药，为何才半天时间就回来了！”
杂役总管胡羽丰横眉竖目，言语凌厉出声。
“根据宗门规矩，不按规定完成任务，要处罚凝气丹三枚，下品灵石三十枚！”
“若有下次，则直接逐出宗门！”
自胡荣死后，他便安排人时时刻刻的盯着苏烬生，就想要抓到丝丝把柄，进行处罚。
方才得知，苏烬生不过登灵药峰半天时间，便已下山。
他直接赶来苏烬生这里，兴师问罪！
苏烬生闻言，脸上露出一抹戏谑的笑容，自己才刚刚进门几息时间。
这杂役总管便紧跟了过来，看来是派人暗中观察他了。
只要自己稍微有点违反宗门规矩的事情，恐怕就会被其严重处置！
为了给胡荣报仇，还真是处心积虑啊！
“总管，你可不要血口喷人！”
“是灵药峰长老命我们二人回来的，我们可没有违反宗门规矩！”
“你放屁！”
“灵药峰任务，需要种植三天灵药，你这才半天时间，怎么可能让你们下山？”
胡羽丰并未思索，而是直接反驳出声。
“快点交出三枚凝气丹，三十枚下品灵石，否则，我便按你拒不接受处罚来算！”
苏烬生脸上露出一个冷笑，如看傻子一样看着胡羽丰。
真不知道胡羽丰的脑子里都装的什么，自己所言连验证都不去验证一下。
就直接将这么一大顶帽子扣了过来。

要知道，拒不接受处罚，会被直接逐出宗门，永远不能再踏入宗门半步。
这等严重的处罚，就算他在紫幕神山待了五年时间，也从未听说过有人受过如此处罚。
“我有令牌作证，乃是灵药峰长老让我们下山收拾东西，搬到灵药峰上居住！”
“从今以后，我和林月舒便归灵药峰管辖，不再属于杂役弟子，受你管辖了！”
说完后，苏烬生便直接拿出长老先前给的令牌，摆在其眼前。
这令牌较为独特，成六角形状，一面是一株灵药的形状，另外一面则是山峰形状！
山峰代表着紫幕神山，灵药则代表着灵药峰。
闻言，胡羽丰双目瞪大，满脸均是不可思议的神色。
要知道，紫幕神山弟子上万，能够加入灵药峰的弟子，也就只有一人而已。
那就是廉妄言，乃是张长老的记名弟子。
如今，自己不过是让苏烬生两人前去种植一下灵药而已，不过半天的时间，怎么就成灵药峰的人了？
苏烬生二人是如何做到的？
心中虽然百般不解，但那枚令牌却是货真价实，做不得假！
一时间，心中怨恨之意再度浓郁几分。
原本只是想要以此方式让苏烬生吃一下苦头，却不曾想，直接将其送入灵药峰中！
简直是搬起石头砸自己的脚，给自己找麻烦！
若是日后苏烬生一直躲在灵药峰中，那报仇岂不是遥遥无期？
毕竟，他的权力再大，也仅限于杂役弟子之中而已。
在灵药峰长老面前，不过只是蝼蚁罢了。
就算是给他一百个胆子，他也不敢杀上灵药峰啊！

“看清楚了吗？杂役总管？”
苏烬生看着胡羽丰那一副哑巴吃黄连，有苦说不出的模样，眉头轻挑，饶有兴致出声道。
“看清楚了就请让路，我现在要前往灵药峰了！”
“若是去晚了，恐怕不太好跟张长老交代啊！”
音落，胡羽丰面色阴沉到了极致，双目犀利，死死盯着苏烬生，心中恨意滔天。
若非是因为顾忌苏烬生当前的身份，真想直接出手，将其拍死当场！
但是他不能，否则的话，他非但身份不保，性命恐怕也难保了。
毕竟，灵药峰张长老的脾气还是让他十分忌惮的。
他只恨自己为何要将种植灵药的任务派给苏烬生！
这下真的是彻底不能奈其何了！
没办法，只能日后寻找机会复仇了！
思索间，极不情愿的向一旁让了一步。
苏烬生看着胡羽丰这幅难看的模样，脸上笑意更加浓郁，戏谑的出声道。
“真喜欢看你这幅想杀我，却又杀不掉的样子！”
说完之后，留下一个鄙夷的眼神，继而迈动步伐走出院外！
“啊！！”
胡羽丰双拳紧握，面部青筋暴露，牙关紧咬，低沉嘶吼出声。
体内，气血涌上心头，直接喷吐而出！
“噗！！”
鲜血洒落地面，极为醒目！

紧接着，咬牙切齿的声音从喉咙中发出。
“苏烬生，你给我等着，若不杀你，誓不为人！！”
苏烬生离开院子后，直奔林月舒的住处，等了约莫一刻钟的时间。
便看见林月舒扛着大包小包的走了出来，小脸上满是笑意。
“我收拾好了烬生哥哥，我们出发吧！”
苏烬生伸手接过其手中的大包小包，意识挥动间便已收入储物戒中。
“走吧！”
林月舒脸上笑容更盛，紧跟着步伐，便随同一起朝着灵药峰走去！
紫幕神山顶端，宗主住处！
“什么！”
“你是说苏烬生不仅恢复了丹田，还突破至炼气五重境了！”
宗主南宫明月一袭白衣，盘坐在原地，美目圆瞪，红唇微张，满脸吃惊之色！
要知道，之前与苏烬生在山洞中温存的时候，他才是炼气一重境啊！
如今不过才三天时间，他竟然就已经突破至炼气五重境了！
这速度，未免也太惊为天人了吧！
就算是五年前的苏烬生，也无法突破的如此之快啊！
难道说，自己那一日的言语，真的鼓励到他了？
“不仅如此，他与那个叫做林月舒的杂役弟子还能种植出全部存活的灵药！”
下方，灵药峰张长老赫然站立，毕恭毕敬出声。
在苏烬生和林月舒离开之后，他便直奔宗主的修炼之处，汇报此事。

其一，是种植灵药全部存活的事情对紫幕神山来说太过有益了，必须上报才行。
其二，则是顺带告知苏烬生丹田恢复的事情。
毕竟，当初宗主还是十分关心此事的！
“全部存活！”
“这，这怎么可能？”
南宫明月美目再次瞪大几分，难以置信的惊呼出声。
作为一宗之主，她可是知道这种植灵药全部存活能够为宗门带来多大的利益。
每个月的收获至少比之前要多出两倍还要多！
灵药峰所炼制的丹药，不仅用来发放给弟子，还会进行售卖。
若是灵药存活率高，炼制的丹药自然就多，可售卖的也就更多！
假以时日，紫幕神山的收益都会因此而壮大数倍！
“千真万确，我亲眼看着他们种下去的近百株银龙草，全部存活！”
张长老言语坚定，丝毫不带有半点开玩笑的意思。
“好！”
“我随同你一起前往看看！”
南宫明月闻言，心中也是有几分激动，当即开口出声！
content_en:
"Su Jinsheng, I ordered you to go to the Spiritual Medicine Peak to plant the spiritual medicine, why did you come back in just half a day!"
Hu Yufeng, the general manager of the handyman, raised his eyebrows and spoke sharply.
"According to the sect's rules, if you don't complete the task according to the regulations, you will be punished with three Qi Condensing Pills and thirty low-grade spiritual stones!"
"If there is a next time, I will be expelled from the sect directly!"
Since Hu Rong's death, he had arranged for people to keep an eye on Su Jinsheng all the time, hoping to find any clues and punish him.
Only then did we learn that Su Jinsheng could only climb the Spiritual Medicine Peak for half a day before he had already descended the mountain.
He came directly to Su Jinsheng to ask for help!
When Su Jinsheng heard this, a joking smile appeared on his face. He had just walked in for a few breaths.
The handyman manager followed closely, and it seemed that he had sent someone to observe him secretly.
As long as you violate the sect's rules even a little bit, I'm afraid you will be severely punished!
In order to avenge Hu Rong, he is really thinking carefully!
"Manager, please don't spit on anyone!"
"It was the elder of Spiritual Medicine Peak who ordered us two to come back. We did not violate the sect's rules!"
"You fart!"
"The elixir peak mission requires three days of planting elixirs. You only have half a day, how can I let you go down the mountain?"
Hu Yufeng did not think about it, but directly retorted.
"Hurry up and hand over the three Qi Condensing Pills and thirty low-grade spiritual stones. Otherwise, I will count on your refusal to accept the punishment!"
Su Jinsheng had a sneer on his face and looked at Hu Yufeng as if he were a fool.
I really don’t know what is going on in Hu Yufeng’s mind. He didn’t even verify what he said.
He just slapped such a big hat on his head.
You must know that if you refuse to accept the punishment, you will be directly expelled from the sect and will never be able to step into the sect again.
Such a serious punishment, even if he had been in the Purple Curtain Mountain for five years, he had never heard of anyone being punished like this.
"I have the token to prove that it was the elder of Spiritual Medicine Peak who asked us to go down the mountain to pack our things and move to Spiritual Medicine Peak!"
"From now on, Lin Yueshu and I will be under the jurisdiction of Spiritual Medicine Peak. We are no longer servant disciples and are under your jurisdiction!"
After saying that, Su Jinsheng directly took out the token given by the elder before and placed it in front of his eyes.
This token is quite unique. It is in the shape of a hexagon. One side is in the shape of an elixir, and the other side is in the shape of a mountain!
The mountain peak represents the Purple Curtain Mountain, and the elixir represents the elixir peak.
Hearing this, Hu Yufeng's eyes widened with an incredible look on his face.
You know, there are tens of thousands of disciples in the Purple Curtain Mountain, but only one disciple can join the Spiritual Medicine Peak.
That is Lian Huanyan, who is the registered disciple of Elder Zhang.
Now, I just asked Su Jinsheng and the others to plant the elixir. How could they become members of the elixir peak in just half a day?
How did Su Jinsheng do it?
Although I was confused in every possible way, the token was genuine and could not be faked!
For a time, the resentment in my heart became stronger again.
Originally, he just wanted to make Su Jinsheng suffer in this way, but he never thought of sending him directly into the Spiritual Medicine Peak!
You are simply shooting yourself in the foot and causing trouble for yourself!
If Su Jinsheng keeps hiding in the Spiritual Medicine Peak in the future, wouldn't revenge be far away?
After all, no matter how great his power was, it was only limited to the handyman disciples.
In front of the elders of Spiritual Medicine Peak, they are nothing more than ants.
Even if he was given a hundred courages, he would not dare to kill the Spiritual Medicine Peak!
"Did you see clearly? Head valet?"
Su Jinsheng looked at the mute Hu Yufeng who was eating Coptidis chinensis and couldn't express the pain. He raised his brows and spoke with interest.
"Please give way when you see it clearly. I'm going to the Spiritual Medicine Peak now!"
"If I arrive late, I'm afraid it won't be easy to explain to Elder Zhang!"
After the sound fell, Hu Yufeng's face became extremely gloomy, his eyes were sharp and he stared at Su Jinsheng with hatred in his heart.monstrous.
If it weren't for Su Jinsheng's current identity, I really wanted to take action and shoot him to death on the spot!
But he can't, otherwise, not only will his identity be protected, but his life may not be saved either.
After all, the temper of Elder Zhang from the Spiritual Medicine Peak still made him very afraid.
He only hated why he assigned Su Jinsheng the task of growing the elixir!
I really can’t do anything about it now!
I have no choice but to look for opportunities for revenge in the future!
While thinking, he reluctantly took a step aside.
Su Jinsheng looked at Hu Yufeng's ugly appearance, the smile on his face became even stronger, and he said jokingly.
"I really like seeing you look like you want to kill me, but you can't!"
After saying that, he left a look of disdain and then walked out of the hospital!
"Ah!!"
Hu Yufeng clenched his fists, exposed the veins on his face, clenched his teeth, and roared in a low voice.
Within the body, qi and blood surged to the heart, spitting out directly!
"Poof!!"
The blood spilled on the ground was extremely eye-catching!
Then, the sound of gnashing teeth came from his throat.
"Su Jinsheng, just wait for me. If I don't kill you, I will never be a human again!!"
After Su Jinsheng left the yard, he went straight to Lin Yueshu's residence and waited for about a quarter of an hour.
Then he saw Lin Yueshu walking out carrying large and small bags, with a smile on her face.
"I've packed up Brother Jinsheng, let's set off!"
Su Jinsheng reached out to take the large and small bags in his hand, and put them into the storage ring in a flash of consciousness.
"Let's go!"
The smile on Lin Yueshu's face became even brighter, and she followed the steps and walked towards the Spiritual Medicine Peak together!
At the top of the Purple Curtain Mountain, the sect leader’s residence!
"What!"
"You're saying that Su Jinsheng not only recovered his Dantian, but also broke through to the fifth level of Qi refining!"
The leader of the clan, Nangong Mingyue, was dressed in white, sitting cross-legged on the spot, her beautiful eyes widened, her red lips slightly parted, and her face full of surprise!
You know, when he and Su Jinsheng were coexisting in the cave, he was at the first level of Qi refining!
Now, in just three days, he has already broken through to the fifth level of Qi refining!
This speed is too shocking!
Even Su Jinsheng five years ago couldn't break through so fast!
Could it be said that his words that day really encouraged him?
"Not only that, he and the handyman disciple named Lin Yueshu were able to grow all the surviving elixirs!"
Below, Elder Zhang from Spiritual Medicine Peak stood proudly and spoke respectfully.
After Su Jinsheng and Lin Yueshu left, he went straight to the sect leader's training place to report the matter.
First, the fact that all the elixirs planted survived are too beneficial to the Purple Curtain Mountain and must be reported.
Secondly, it was to inform Su Jinsheng about the recovery of Dantian.
After all, the sect leader was still very concerned about this matter back then!
"All survive!"
"This, how is this possible?"
Nangong Mingyue's beautiful eyes widened again, and she exclaimed in disbelief.
As the leader of a sect, she knows how much benefit the sect can bring if all the elixirs planted survive.
The harvest every month is at least twice as much as before!
The elixirs refined at Spiritual Medicine Peak are not only used to distribute to disciples, but are also sold.
If the survival rate of the elixir is high, naturally more elixirs can be refined and more can be sold!
Over time, Zimu Shenshan’s income will increase several times because of this!
"It's absolutely true. I saw with my own eyes that nearly a hundred Silver Dragon Grass plants they planted all survived!"
Elder Zhang's words were firm and did not mean the slightest bit of joking.
"Okay!"
"I'll go with you to have a look!"
When Nangong Mingyue heard this, she was a little excited and immediately spoke out!
